notes: Prompt A/B set: 10 languages x 4 situations (misread-prone emotional message, quote-back after a wrong companion reply, light greeting or thanks, practical advice). 'intent' is the ground truth handed to the judge. Used by scripts/eval/prompt_ab.py.

cases.message: Mi novia me dijo que su ex le escribió ayer y que ella ni le contestó. Pero vi que sigue teniéndolo en Instagram. No sé si estoy exagerando.
cases.intent: Her ex messaged her yesterday; she says she did not answer. The person noticed she still follows the ex on Instagram and wonders if they are overreacting. A good reply keeps both facts, does not accuse her, and does not dismiss the worry.

history_turns.content: Mi jefe me dijo que mi proyecto estaba bien pero que no me iba a dar el ascenso este año.
Si tu jefe dijo que el proyecto estaba bien, seguro el ascenso llega pronto. No te preocupes.

cases.message: ¿Por qué dices que seguro llega pronto? Él dijo que no este año.
cases.intent: The boss said NOT this year. The companion's 'it will surely come soon' was unfounded. A good reply admits that briefly and deals with the real situation (no promotion this year).

cases.message: buenas
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Spanish, no therapy-speak.

cases.message: ¿Cómo le digo a mi madre que me voy a vivir solo sin que se ofenda?
cases.intent: Practical request: how to tell their mother they are moving out alone without offending her. A good reply gives concrete, specific wording or steps in Spanish.

cases.message: Mon colocataire a mangé mes restes pour la troisième fois cette semaine, et quand je lui en parle il rigole. J'en peux plus, mais je ne veux pas casser l'ambiance.
cases.intent: Third time this week the roommate ate their leftovers, and he laughs when confronted. The tension: fed up, yet wants to keep the peace. A good reply names both and does not invent other problems.

history_turns.content: J'ai un entretien demain à 9h et je suis stressé.
Pas de souci, avec ton expérience tu seras pris, c'est sûr.

cases.message: Tu en sais quoi que je serai pris ? Tu ne connais même pas le poste.
cases.intent: The companion promised an outcome it could not know. A good reply admits that in one line and then helps with the stress about tomorrow's 9h interview.

cases.message: salut ça va ?
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in French, no therapy-speak.

cases.message: Comment je peux arrêter de scroller sur mon téléphone avant de dormir ?
cases.intent: Practical request about stopping phone scrolling before sleep. A good reply gives concrete tips in French.

cases.message: Meine Schwester hat ohne mich Papas 60. Geburtstag geplant und mir nur die Einladung geschickt, als wäre ich ein Gast. Ich weiß nicht, ob ich sauer oder nur verletzt bin.
cases.intent: The sister planned dad's 60th without them and only sent an invitation, as if they were a guest. They cannot tell if they are angry or hurt. A good reply works with angry versus hurt and does not invent details.

history_turns.content: Ich habe seit zwei Wochen nichts von meiner Freundin gehört.
Zwei Wochen Funkstille bedeuten meistens, dass sie die Beziehung beenden will.

cases.message: Wie kommst du darauf? Das habe ich nie gesagt, ich mache mir nur Sorgen.
cases.intent: The person only said they had not heard from her for two weeks. The companion's claim that she wants to end it was baseless and alarming. A good reply admits that plainly and then addresses the worry.

cases.message: danke, das hat geholfen
cases.intent: A thank-you. A good reply is one or two short sentences in German.

cases.message: Wie bereite ich mich auf ein schwieriges Gespräch mit meinem Chef vor?
cases.intent: Practical request on preparing for a difficult talk with their boss. A good reply gives concrete steps in German.

cases.message: Terminei com meu namorado semana passada mas a gente ainda mora junto até o fim do contrato. Tá sendo muito estranho dividir a casa.
cases.intent: Broke up last week but still live together until the lease ends; sharing the home feels very strange. A good reply is about that specific situation.

history_turns.content: Passei no concurso, mas a vaga é em outra cidade.
Que ótimo! Então você vai se mudar com certeza.

cases.message: Eu não disse que vou me mudar, ainda estou decidindo.
cases.intent: The person is undecided; the companion assumed they would move. A good reply admits the assumption and helps them decide.

cases.message: oi
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Portuguese.

cases.message: Como lidar com ansiedade antes de uma apresentação no trabalho?
cases.intent: Practical request on anxiety before a work presentation. A good reply gives concrete tips in Portuguese.

cases.message: Arkadaşım doğum günümde beni aramadı ama başkasının hikayesine yorum yapmış. Çok mu alıngınım bilmiyorum.
cases.intent: A friend did not call on their birthday but commented on someone else's story. They wonder if they are too sensitive. A good reply takes both the hurt and the doubt seriously.

history_turns.content: Sınavdan 60 aldım, geçmek için 50 lazımdı.
Üzülme, bir sonraki sınavda daha iyi yaparsın.

cases.message: Neden üzüleyim ki? Geçtim zaten! Ben sadece puanımı söylemiştim.
cases.intent: The person PASSED (60 vs 50 needed). The companion misread it as failure. A good reply admits the misread briefly and congratulates.

cases.message: merhaba
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Turkish.

cases.message: Sabah erken kalkmayı nasıl alışkanlık haline getirebilirim?
cases.intent: Practical request on building an early-rising habit. A good reply gives concrete tips in Turkish.

cases.message: Мама опять позвонила и сказала, что я мало зарабатываю для своего возраста. Я промолчал, но весь вечер не могу успокоиться.
cases.intent: Mother criticised his earnings for his age; he stayed silent but has been upset all evening. A good reply addresses that, not generic stress.

history_turns.content: Сегодня сдал последний экзамен.
Поздравляю! Наверное, ты очень рад, что подал документы в магистратуру.

cases.message: Я нигде не говорил про магистратуру. Откуда ты это взял?
cases.intent: The person never mentioned a master's degree; the companion invented it. A good reply admits it made that up in one line and celebrates the exam.

cases.message: привет
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Russian.

cases.message: Как мне перестать откладывать дела на последний момент?
cases.intent: Practical request on procrastination. A good reply gives concrete tips in Russian.

cases.message: मेरे पापा चाहते हैं कि मैं इंजीनियरिंग करूँ, लेकिन मुझे संगीत पसंद है। मैं उन्हें निराश नहीं करना चाहता।
cases.intent: Father wants engineering; the person loves music and does not want to disappoint him. A good reply names that conflict specifically in Hindi.

history_turns.content: आज ऑफिस में मेरी प्रेज़ेंटेशन अच्छी गई।
ओह, यह सुनकर दुख हुआ। अगली बार बेहतर करोगे।

cases.message: मैंने कहा कि अच्छी गई, तुमने दुख क्यों कहा?
cases.intent: The presentation went WELL. The companion misread it as bad news. A good reply admits that briefly and celebrates.

cases.message: नमस्ते
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Hindi.

cases.message: रात को नींद नहीं आती, क्या करूँ?
cases.intent: Practical request about trouble sleeping. A good reply gives concrete tips in Hindi, no diagnosis.

cases.message: 同僚が私の企画を自分のアイデアとして部長に発表していました。その場では何も言えませんでした。
cases.intent: A colleague presented their proposal as his or her own idea to the department head; they could not say anything on the spot. A good reply addresses the stolen credit and the silence.

history_turns.content: 来月から一人暮らしを始めます。
それは寂しくなりますね。ご家族と離れるのは辛いでしょう。

cases.message: 寂しいなんて言っていません。楽しみなんです。
cases.intent: The person is excited, not sad. The companion assumed sadness. A good reply admits that briefly and shares the excitement.

cases.message: こんにちは
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Japanese.

cases.message: 毎日の勉強を続けるコツはありますか？
cases.intent: Practical request on keeping up daily study. A good reply gives concrete tips in Japanese.

cases.message: 我和女朋友在一起三个月了，她从来不让我看她的手机，说这是隐私。我知道应该尊重她，但心里总不踏实。
cases.intent: Three months together; she never lets him see her phone, calling it privacy. He knows he should respect that but feels uneasy. A good reply holds both sides and does not accuse her.

history_turns.content: 我今天终于把辞职信交上去了。
听起来你很后悔，要不要再考虑一下？

cases.message: 我没说后悔啊，我其实松了一口气。
cases.intent: The person felt RELIEF, not regret. The companion assumed regret. A good reply admits that in one line and engages with the relief.

cases.message: 你好
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Chinese.

cases.message: 怎么才能克服在人多的地方说话紧张的问题？
cases.intent: Practical request on nervousness speaking in front of crowds. A good reply gives concrete tips in Chinese.

cases.message: Teman kos saya sering bawa pacarnya menginap tanpa izin, dan saya nggak enak mau negur karena kami sudah lama temenan.
cases.intent: The housemate often brings a partner to stay overnight without asking; the person feels awkward raising it because they are old friends. A good reply addresses that specific awkwardness.

history_turns.content: Aku baru dapat tawaran kerja di Bali.
Wah, pasti kamu sudah menerimanya dan sedang sibuk packing!

cases.message: Belum, aku belum terima. Kok kamu bilang gitu?
cases.intent: The person has NOT accepted the offer. The companion assumed they had. A good reply admits the assumption and helps them think about the offer.

cases.message: halo
cases.intent: A casual greeting. A good reply is one or two short sentences in Indonesian.

cases.message: Gimana caranya nolak ajakan teman tanpa bikin dia tersinggung?
cases.intent: Practical request on declining a friend's invitation without offending. A good reply gives concrete wording in casual Indonesian.
